meta.source: Interview and foundations v0.2 (2026-10-13), realigned to Tailwind v4 and shadcn/ui (2026-10-15)

tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Page ground. Primary text is foreground (15.6:1 dark, 16.3:1 light).

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on background, surface-1, surface-2 and surface-3.

tokens.name: surface-1
tokens.usage: First step up from background: cards, muted fills, input fills, row hover. Group with this tone instead of a border.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Second step: secondary buttons, selected rows, accent hover, code blocks in tools.

tokens.name: surface-3
tokens.usage: Third step: hover on secondary, switch track off, active segmented item (dark).

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: shadcn role. Grouped content blocks; no border.

tokens.name: card-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on card.

tokens.name: popover
tokens.usage: Menus, toasts, tooltips. Always paired with a 1px border edge; the one floating layer that keeps a line.

tokens.name: popover-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on popover.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Emerald. The single main action per view, links, checked controls, success. Never for decoration or 'good' numbers. Under 5% of any screen.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state of primary fills.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary (8.0:1 dark, 5.0:1 light).

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: shadcn role. Filled secondary buttons.

tokens.name: secondary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover of secondary.

tokens.name: secondary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on secondary.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: shadcn role. Quiet fills: inputs, code, empty states.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Supporting text on background, surface-1, surface-2 and popover; at least 4.8:1 on each in both themes.

tokens.name: subtle-foreground
tokens.usage: Retry addition. Placeholders, timestamps, column headers, captions: one step quieter than muted-foreground. Only on background, surface-1 and sidebar (3.1 to 3.6:1): never for body text, never on popover.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: shadcn role: NEUTRAL hover and selected background (not the brand color).

tokens.name: accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on accent.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions, as text or a dot on background (5.7:1 dark, 5.2:1 light).

tokens.name: destructive-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind destructive buttons and error notices; text on it is destructive.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success shares the emerald; always paired with a word.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warnings, as text or a dot on background (7.7:1 dark, 5.0:1 light).

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind warning notices; text on it is warning plus muted-foreground.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline for table rows and the edge of floating layers only. Never box a group with it.

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: 1px inset edge of fields, checkboxes and radios on surface-1. Below 3:1 by choice; the fill and the focus ring carry the boundary.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset. At least 4.5:1 on background and surface-1 in both themes.

tokens.name: ring-soft
tokens.usage: 3px halo around a focused field, outside the ring-colored edge.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: Navigation column, one step darker than background in dark.

tokens.name: sidebar-foreground
tokens.usage: Inactive nav items on sidebar (6.3:1 dark, 5.2:1 light).

tokens.name: sidebar-primary
tokens.usage: Workspace mark and primary action inside the sidebar.

tokens.name: sidebar-primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on sidebar-primary.

tokens.name: sidebar-accent
tokens.usage: Active and hovered nav item fill.

tokens.name: sidebar-accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Active nav item text.

tokens.name: sidebar-border
tokens.usage: Kept for shadcn parity; transparent. The sidebar is separated by tone.

tokens.name: sidebar-ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring inside the sidebar.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Series 1, or the one highlighted series. Others use chart-5 when only one matters.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Series 2.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Series 3.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Series 4.

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Series 5 and de-emphasised series.

groups.name: Tailwind scale
groups.note: Tailwind v4 default sizes and line heights. Inter's optical sizing handles small text; Retry only gives text-3xl and up tracking-tight (-0.025em) and opens the line height of 5xl and 6xl.

styles.name: text-6xl
styles.usage: Cover and the rare one-line statement.

styles.name: text-5xl
styles.sample: I design and build tools that stay out of the way.

styles.name: text-3xl
styles.sample: What changed in the second draft

styles.name: text-2xl
styles.usage: Slide subheads, large numbers in stat blocks.

styles.name: text-base
styles.usage: Site copy and longer interface text.

styles.name: text-sm
styles.usage: Interface text: buttons, inputs, menus, rows, table cells, sidebar. Labels at 500.

styles.name: text-xs
styles.usage: Metadata, timestamps, column headers, group labels, field help.

groups.name: Code
groups.note: font-mono is for code and data only, never headings or labels.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: font-mono text-sm. Code blocks and inline code.

spacing.note: Tailwind's default 4px scale, listed only for the steps Retry uses. Write the utilities (gap-2, p-4), never these values.

tokens.name: spacing-1
tokens.usage: gap-1: icon to label.

tokens.name: spacing-2
tokens.usage: gap-2: between buttons; label to field.

tokens.name: spacing-3
tokens.usage: px-3: control padding; gap-3 inside rows.

tokens.name: spacing-4
tokens.usage: p-4: card padding; gap-4 between related groups.

tokens.name: spacing-6
tokens.usage: p-6: tool panel padding; gap-6 between field rows.

tokens.name: spacing-8
tokens.usage: gap-8: between blocks in a section.

tokens.name: spacing-12
tokens.usage: py-12: between sections in tools; site gutters.

tokens.name: spacing-16
tokens.usage: py-16: between site sections.

radius.note: shadcn's default --radius (0.625rem) is the base; the rest derive from it. Change --radius to make everything rounder or squarer.

tokens.name: radius
tokens.usage: Base, = rounded-lg: dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: rounded-sm = radius - 4: items inside controls and menus.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: rounded-md = radius - 2: buttons, inputs, popovers, menus, tooltips.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: rounded-xl = radius + 4: cards.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: rounded-2xl = radius + 8: emphasised containers, slides.

easing.note: Durations are Tailwind's duration-150 (color) and duration-200 (movement).

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Overrides Tailwind's --ease-out, so the ease-out utility carries Retry's curve. No spring or overshoot.
